subject: San Diego product launch — deposit request & PO setup
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: San Diego launch — need deposit sign-off and PO setup

Hi Marissa / Ben,

We just received an updated venue invoice from BrightWave — they’re asking for a 50% deposit to hold the main ballroom for the San Diego product launch (final event date: 2027-03-22). Attachment: venue_invoice_v2.pdf.

Quick summary: 
- Total venue fee: $28,500 (line items in cost_breakdown_san_diego.xlsx attached)
- Deposit requested: $14,250 (due by 2027-01-15)
- Remaining balance due 30 days before event

Ask: can finance raise a PO for the deposit (or process P-card payment if that’s faster)? We also need the cost center and GL mapping so I can include the right coding on the PO.

Requirements from vendor:
- PO or signed invoice + payment confirmation before 1/15
- DocuSign deposit form available here: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-SD-Deposit

If we go the PO route I can attach the PO draft to the vendor. I’ve mocked up numbers in the attached workbook — please review and note any adjustments. We’ll need sign-off today or tomorrow so we don’t lose the ballroom.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Jan 8, 2027 at 09:12 Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> We just received an updated venue invoice from BrightWave — they’re asking for a 50% deposit to hold the main ballroom...

Thanks Sofia — two quick clarifying q's before I route to finance:
1) Which cost center should we use? Product marketing (4102) or Events (4301)?
2) Do you prefer a 1x advance (vendor deposit) or P-card payment? P-card is faster but has the $10k single-swipe limit unless we get an exception.

If you can confirm cost center and preferred payment, I’ll submit the PO request today with the PO total = $14,250 and attach the invoice.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Finance Business Partner, Growth

Ben / Sofia,

Confirmed details after quick run with the Events ops team:
- Use cost center 4301 (Events) and GL 7200 (Event Production).
- Vendor requires 50% deposit to secure the ballroom; they will not hold the date without it.
- Because of the P-card single-swipe limit, we should raise a PO for a vendor check/ACH. Finance can mark it as an advance (deposit) so the remaining balance is captured later.

I attached a PO draft (po_draft_sd_launch_001.pdf) with the deposit line and a short statement of work for the vendor. Please change any GL or routing if needed, otherwise Ben — please submit to finance with priority (target: PO issued by 1/12).

Couple of operational notes for the PO:
- Vendor legal: BrightWave Events LLC (EIN on the invoice)
- Billing remit: accounts@brightwave.com
- Contact: Liam O'Connor, 415-555-0199

Thanks — I’ll prep the vendor confirmation once the PO/ payment is confirmed.

—Marissa
